general_summary:
joão nuno macedo, arquitectos is a portuguese architecture studio, based in Braga. The practice positions itself between the architecture exercise and the contemporary realities of the user, throughout a negotiation process between the parts until reaching a final result. It´s our belief that more than proposing a finished design of a certain space, the architecture exercise is, fundamentally, to imbue space with the ability to adapt to the needs of the contemporary user with a clear sense of the character of each programmatic space, of its potentialities and care for a human harmonic scale.

general_summary: It is in Lisbon’s prestigious Bairro do Chiado that ARQ TAILOR’S develops its Architecture and Interior Design projects. In a sober and creative style, the tailor made projects signed by ARQ TAILOR´S stand out for their elegance in a unique and timeless style, creating functional and comfortable spaces aligned with the specific needs of individual clients. With a joyful and young team, the studio is known for the subtle blend of refinement and modernity in its projects, designed for both residential and commercial spaces for Portuguese and foreign clients. ARQ TAILOR´S also provides Landscaping and consultancy services in Arts and Antiques, offering its clients a wide range of very exclusive services.

Maxime Mangold is a young architect based in Lyon (France) and Lisbon (Portugal). Since 2019, he has been developing projects of different types at different scales. With the aim of simplicity and sustainability, the office conducts a reflection and specific support for each project. This results in a rational and fresh architectural language where each decision is taken transparently with the client for the benefit of the final object.

“POSTO 9” develops works in the scope of architecture, urbanism, and construction supervision, operating in various national and international geographical areas, and having particular vocation to act as a privileged partner in the development of projects in Portuguese-speaking territory. The entrepreneurial strategy consists on the excellence of service rendering and on a close relationship with the clients, supporting their investments in the quest for maximum quality with an effective cost control. The programmatic and geographical diversity of the elaborated projects is supported by an action of coordination of multidisciplinary teams, where companies accredited in the different technical areas participate. The “POSTO 9 arquitectos” company was founded in Lisbon in 2004, having as managing partners the architects: André Ferreira and Joana Castanheira.

Cremascoli Okumura Rodrigues arquitectos studio is created in 2001 in Porto, Portugal. The studio wins several international competions, prizes and recognitions. The most important are Sea Sciences and Technologies Centre, Matosinhos, Portugal; Rehabilitation of the Old Resin Factory, Marinha Grande, Portugal; “Piazza Garibaldi” urban requalification, Cantù, Italy The project for the Renovation of the "Grande Hotel do Porto" is selected for the first edition of the event "RESPECT FOR ARCHITECTURE." Currently the office is developing projects in Portugal, Italy, France, Switzerland and Great Britain. In Italy, the studio has projects with Architect Alvaro Siza.
